title: A sky, received three ways.
subtitle: UDP  ·  QUIC  ·  SHARED MEMORY  /  One connection per door; each door's newest message becomes its picture.
footer: sender.py beside this sketch sends the UDP and shared memory doors; Seer speaks QUIC  ·  Captures replay the three recordings under data/

doors.label: UDP · SCHEMA
doors.note: A datagram per sky, read through feed_sky.fbs: an arrival that does not fit the schema is counted, never drawn.

doors.label: QUIC · JSON
doors.note: One encrypted stream per sky, answered with the self-signed pair beside this sketch and read as plain JSON.

doors.label: SHARED MEMORY · JSON
doors.note: A region another process on this machine wrote, mapped read-only: no socket and no copy through the kernel.
